issues.issue: Whether the officer reasonably assessed establishment, or applied an 'exceptional' establishment standard
issues.applicant_position: Officer set an impossible threshold requiring exceptional establishment and ignored personalized evidence.
issues.respondent_position: Officer reasonably considered efforts and gave some weight to establishment; 'exceptional' was used descriptively.
issues.result_text: Officer erred by not explaining why establishment and integration evidence did not show hardship or exceptional establishment.

issues.issue: Whether the officer reasonably assessed hardship from health care conditions and medication access in Nigeria
issues.applicant_position: Officer ignored evidence that key medications are unavailable in Nigeria and contradicted himself on cost.
issues.respondent_position: Applicants bore onus to show medications unavailable; Adedeji case lacked such evidence; ability to pay was reasonably assessed.
issues.result_text: Conclusion on health care hardship lacks justification as some medications are unavailable; insecurity arguments were rejected.

issues.issue: Whether the officer erred in its best interests of the children assessment
issues.applicant_position: Officer erred in assessing best interests of the children.
issues.result_text: Not separately addressed in the points; the decision turned on establishment and medical evidence.
